meta.revisionPolicy: Each indicator is final as its underlying source publishes; the compendium is a curated cross-source portrait, never a single survey.
meta.coverage: Percentage distribution of workers in usual status (ps+ss) by broad industry division (PLFS, original design, calendar years)
meta.cut: Rural or urban, sex and industry
meta.note: MoSPI's compendium reprints this table from Periodic Labour Force Survey, National Statistics Office, MoSPI; the figures are that agency's. This bundle holds one instrument only (PLFS, original design, calendar years); the indicator's other instrument is a separate bundle, never joined to this one. Values printed as "-" (no observation) or "NR" (not reported) are not baked; meta.omitted counts them.
